headlines.headline: June FOMC Minutes: Staff Sees Inflation Sticky at 3% Into Q3 on Tariff Pass-Through
headlines.driver: For TLT: Negative — staff sticky 3% into Q3 anchors market's no-cut-to-2028 view, keeping TLT range-bound 4.5-4.7% until CPI breaks; explains why TLT hasn't rallied despite hold.

headlines.headline: June CPI Preview: Cleveland Fed Nowcast 0.31% MoM — Markets Price 70% Hold for July
headlines.driver: For TLT: Neutral — hawkish nowcast preview kept TLT on back foot before July; actual cooler CPI shows nowcast overshoot risk, which is bullish for TLT if August 0.38% nowcast also overshoots.
